home.title: Nicolas Planche
home.subtitle: Full-Stack & Mobile Developer
home.description1: I design, build and evolve web and mobile applications in production, from back-end to user interface, with a constant focus on code quality and reliable delivery.
home.description2: I mainly work with Laravel, Nuxt.js and Flutter, as well as Next.js and React. These technologies are my foundation, not a boundary: I adapt to the tools each project requires.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Applications built for production.
about.description1: As a full-stack and mobile developer, I have been working since 2022 on web and mobile applications used in production, both in companies and as a freelancer.
about.description2: I work across the whole product lifecycle: building new features, evolving existing applications, integrating third-party services (payments, CRM, notifications), refactoring legacy code and making delivery safer.
about.description3: I treat maintainability as a requirement, not an option: readable code, structured architecture, automated tests and traceability in production. An application should be able to evolve without every change becoming a risk.
about.description4: I have taken part in technical decisions and architecture changes, including refactoring legacy code into DDD-inspired modules and designing a white-label solution deployed for partner clubs.
about.description5: I have also built up project management and technical coordination experience. During my internship, I ran a project on my own, from gathering requirements to going live. At SportCorico, I structured how the technical team worked: sprints, prioritization, code reviews, CI/CD. At Liberlo, I take part in scoping features with the Lead Tech and the Product Owner. As a freelancer, I run projects end to end, from scoping to maintenance.
about.description6: I keep deepening the stacks I use every day, and I remain open to new languages, frameworks and environments whenever they better fit a project's needs.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: From scoping to production.
projects.description: Client applications, personal products and open-source tools: each project shown here answers a concrete need and was carried through to a usable result, with the same standards of structure, reliability and maintainability.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: A solid stack, choices driven by real needs.
skills.description: I work across the whole development chain: mobile, front-end, back-end, tooling and production. I keep deepening the technologies I use every day, such as Laravel, Nuxt.js and Flutter, and I readily skill up on other languages, frameworks or environments when a project calls for it, with the same standard: understanding their principles before using them in production.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.subtitle: Applications in production, in a team and on my own.
experiences.description1: My background is built on real products: a booking platform in the wellness field, a sports web and mobile application offered as a white-label solution, and freelance projects for various clients.
experiences.description2: I handled full-stack development, third-party integrations, architecture refactoring and testing, as well as technical coordination: organizing sprints, reviewing code, setting up CI/CD and working closely with product and QA teams.

education.title: Education
education.subtitle: Solid theoretical foundations, strengthened by practice.
education.description1: My Bachelor's degree in Mathematics and Computer Science at Claude Bernard University Lyon 1 gave me solid foundations in algorithms, programming and logical reasoning, which I rely on every day to design well-structured solutions.
education.description2: I then completed the Full-Stack Developer Master's at MyDigitalSchool Lyon as a work-study student at SportCorico. This format let me apply what I learned, from web and mobile development to project management, directly on an application in production.
